The Template Update Problem
Iain Matthews, Takahiro Ishikawa, and Simon Baker
The Robotics Institute
Carnegie Mellon University
Abstract
Template tracking dates back to the 1981 Lucas-Kanade algorithm. One question that has
received very little attention, however, is how to update the template so that it remains a good
model of the tracked object. We propose a template update algorithm that avoids the “drifting”
inherent in the naive algorithm.
Keywords: Template tracking, the Lucas-Kanade algorithm, active appearance models.
